name: empty-state
title: Empty state
description: The designed void: what this is, why it is empty, and the one action that fills it.

standards.purpose: Turn an empty list into an invitation, not a dead end.
useWhen: A list, search, or filter can legitimately be empty.
doNotUseWhen: Loading is still in flight — skeletons own that moment, not empty states.

rules.check: State what it is, why it is empty, and offer at most the one action that fills it.
